briefing: 今日导读：今天的AI新闻涉及前沿技术的进展，包括视力恢复芯片移植、个人AI助手的普及预测，以及机器人智能API的发布。这些发展可能预示着技术边界的重新定义和应用范围的扩大。
highlights: 今日看点：Science Corporation的视力恢复芯片移植成功与Cerebras对个人AI助手未来的愿景，揭示了生物技术与AI助手普及的交汇点；此外，Physical Intelligence API和MiniCPM-V 4.7的能力展示表明，AI在物理环境处理和多模态任务上的潜力不断扩大，这些事件共同指出，AI正从实验室走向更广泛的现实应用，推动各行各业的技术革新。

events.title: Science Corporation 移植视力恢复芯片
events.summary: Science Corporation 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 上宣布，成功为首位罹患 Stargardt 病的患者植入了恢复视力的芯片。公司联合创始人兼前总裁 Max Hodak 介绍了与 PRIMA 的合作，这也是实现新型脑机接口（BCI）的一部分。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
Science Corporation成功植入了一款视力恢复芯片，这代表了一种能够与生物系统直接互动的脑机接口技术。

### 为什么令人兴奋
这种芯片的成功植入显示了在恢复视力领域技术的一大步进展，有可能大大提高罹患相关疾病患者的生活质量。

### 产品机会
这项技术可能催生更多生物技术和医疗设备的创新，尤其是在神经系统接口方面的发展和应用。

### 格局影响
这将对医疗器械行业、AI和生物技术的结合发展产生深远影响，扩大市场参与者的技术应用边界。

### 冷静判断
尽管此项技术显示出巨大潜力，但其商业化普及仍需时日，需要进一步临床实验和效果验证。

### 趋势坐标
该事件呼应了最近AI在健康医疗领域应用扩展的趋势，与前两周AI与生物数据的融合投资相呼应。

articles.text: CANADA - 2025/07/20: In this photo illustration, the Shopify logo is seen displayed on a smartphone screen. (Photo Illustration by Thomas Fuller/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images) More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the company's agentic commerce ambitions. Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify's catalog. (The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September, Shopify announced it was partnering with Meta to allow its Muse agent to browse and purchase items on a human's behalf; now, shoppers can use any agent without a partnership integration. articles.text: Retro gaming is going through a wild time at the moment, thanks to decompilations and recompilations that are letting gamers port classic titles to new devices, or merge code from two different games into a single new experience. Microsoft has witnessed skateboarding being modded into Call of Duty and Halo being played in a web browser , and the company is now officially embracing the chaos of this new AI-powered era of game modding. Microsoft is putting together a new Xbox Labs group to explore the rapid emergence of these mods, many of which use AI models to help modders remix games in ways we've rarely seen before. articles.text: Epic Games plans to use AI to generate code and art for an unannounced Disney game, which is now delayed from its original March release window, according to a report from Bloomberg . The project's developers have been given an "AI-first" mandate directing them to use tools like Anthropic's Claude more to finish the game. According to Bloomberg , one of the game's directors said in a message to staff, "No more hand-written code." Staff were also told that all of the game's art will be "generated with full AI workflows." articles.title: Google finally releases Gemini 4 Argon
articles.text: After months sitting on the sidelines of the frontier AI race, Google has finally launched its long-awaited Gemini 4 Argon model, claiming it can compete with the best the industry has to offer. The company claims Argon outperforms rival models like GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 across a range of benchmarks, including coding, cybersecurity, science, finance, and law.
